title: Controlled MySQL read failure for uncached orders
description: The order service remains healthy but an uncached order read returns an explicit 503 while the controlled MySQL read fault is active.
observable_symptoms: uncached order read returns HTTP 503 with DEMO_MYSQL_UNAVAILABLE

expected_evidence.logs: current MySQL injection followed by order_mysql_read_failed
expected_evidence.trace: Java order-request span contains failed read path

verification: first fresh order read loads from MySQL and populates Redis
second order read is a Redis cache hit
